title: Comments Repeating Code (Restating the Obvious)
pattern: A comment on a line of code that merely translates the adjacent identifiers and operators into prose without adding any context or intent.
why_bad: It increases visual noise and maintenance overhead. Since code changes rapidly, these comments quickly get out of sync, becoming misleading and creating a breeding ground for lies.
detection: Prose in the comment matches the exact syntactic identifiers or operator semantics of the adjacent active line of code.
counterexample: Explaining a subtle domain-specific invariant or a hardware-level quirk that is not apparent from the code alone.
source: Kent Beck, *Tidy First* (2023), Chapter 15 ("Delete Redundant Comments"), pp. 29-31; Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code* (2008), Chapter 4, p. 61.
